name: One Night Liar
source:
"Who killed "me"?"

You infiltrate a luxury cruise ship reunion pretending to be the murdered woman.

Whether you can identify the killer without being discovered depends on your "lies."

A one-night-only deception adventure game.
translation:
“谁杀了‘我’？”

你假装是被谋杀的女人，潜入豪华游轮聚会。

能否在不被发现的情况下指认凶手，取决于你的“谎言”。

一款仅限一晚的欺骗冒险游戏。
